name: project-operator
body: A thing that uses the system: the CLI user (human or agent) invoking the `apg` mutation surface. Uses `apg project start/merge/delete` for project lifecycle (delete is the discard act for abandoned, never-merged projects), and the `apg node`/`apg edge`/`apg plan` add|update|rm commands whose strictness this requirement tree specifies. Interest in tooling-review: `add` refuses on an existing entity, `update` preserves every incident edge, and `rm` actually lands (stages its deletions) without silently replacing records.
